reason: A collaboration plugin for point-to-point messaging between local dsh and other agent sessions, with peer registration, discovery, message sending, inbound context injection, and an interactive peer list.

summaries.zh: 在本机 dsh 与其他智能体会话之间通过 Unix socket 注册、发现并收发消息，并提供可交互的 peer 列表。
summaries.en: Enables point-to-point messaging between local dsh and other agent sessions over Unix sockets, with peer discovery and an interactive peer list.

capabilities: Registers a local agent peer over Unix sockets
Receives peer messages and injects them into agent context
Provides an interactive peer list and message interface
